## Return to Pakistan 2024 is organized by cubingPakistan

cubingPakistan, Pakistan's WCA recognized Regional Organization is pleased to announce that competitions are returning to Pakistan after 5 years.

### Media

Please follow [cubingPakistan](http://cubingpakistan.com/) on social media to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

* [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/cubingpakistan/)
* [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/cubingpakistan/?igsh=MWI4bTRtdnd1OHZsNQ%3D%3D)

### Notice of Filming and Photography
Attendees of cubingPakistan competitions consent to their images being used by cubingPakistan and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
